label: Quotient email broadcast Metrics tab
description: The Quotient EMAIL BROADCAST METRICS screen, hand-built from the real product: a top bar with line tabs (Metrics active / Recipients / Details / Editor) and, on the right, the kebab + share buttons, the campaign chip (blue megaphone, campaign name, 'n/m' + green progress ring), 'Threads (3) ↗' and a green-rocket 'Sent 3 days ago' status; four KPI tiles with icons (Total Emails Sent, Delivery Rate, Open Rate, Click Rate); the 'Broadcast Engagement Funnel' bar chart (1. Sent / 2. Delivered / 3. Opened / 4. Clicked, y-axis 0..max with gridlines, auto nice scale); and the 'Want to dig deeper?' card with 'Open reports →' and a black 'Ask the agent' button. Every word and number comes from data (defaults: a strong Q3 Flows launch email -- 18,400 sent, 99.20% delivered, 52.40% open, 11.80% click; funnel 18,400 → 18,253 → 9,565 → 2,154 on a 0-20000 axis so Clicked reads as a real bar). ENTRANCE (scrub-safe, all on the timeline): the header chips fade up and the campaign ring draws, the tiles land with a stagger and their numbers ROLL UP through the final format (thousands separators, %, $, K/M), the funnel card lands, gridlines + ticks fade in and the bars GROW from the baseline one after another, then the footer card. data.at shifts the whole entrance; entrance:'none' shows the settled screen from frame 0 (stills). SCRIPT verbs (data.script, [{action, at, ...}]): count {target: tile label | 'kpi-N' | funnel stage ('Clicked' | 'stage-N'), to, display?, duration?} rolls a tile's number (or grows a funnel bar) from its current value to a new one; highlight {target: tile label | stage | tab | 'kpis'|'funnel'|'footer'|'campaign'|'threads'|'Ask the agent'|any visible text, duration?, color?, hold?} -- accent ring + wash; switch-tab {to: 'Recipients'}; set-text {target: current text, to}; plus the shared cursor verbs move-cursor / click / hover / wait (targets by visible text: 'Ask the agent', 'Open reports', 'Threads', 'Recipients', a tile label, a stage label -- resolved to the real element). CAMERA ANCHORS: header, tabs, kpis, kpi-0..kpi-3, funnel, chart, stage-0..stage-3, footer. PLACEMENT: sits in quotient-app-shell's content well -- shell at x 1.2%, y 2%, width 97.6%, height 96% with show_panel:false and nav_active:'email' (breadcrumbs e.g. ['Email', 'Q3 launch email · Try Flows free']), this component at x 4.7%, y 8%, width 93.7%, height 89% with docked:true. Standalone (docked false) it is a white rounded card with a visible border + shadow. Laid out in the capture's px off the box width (1300u across, refits on resize), so it reads the same at any size; the funnel card takes the spare height.

tabs.label: Top-bar tabs: strings or {label, icon?: metrics|recipients|details|editor} (default Metrics, Recipients, Details, Editor)

campaign.label: Campaign chip name (default 'Q3 Flows Launch'; ellipsizes past ~128px like the product). false hides the chip

campaign_progress.label: Chip progress text 'n/m' (default '4/4'); the green ring fills to n/m

threads.label: Threads count in 'Threads (N) ↗' (default 3). false hides it

status.label: Sent status text beside the green rocket (default 'Sent 3 days ago'). false hides it

kpis.label: KPI tiles: [{label, icon?: send|check|open|click|users|reply|dollar|trending|bounce|eye (false = none), value: number or '52.4%' (rolls up), format?: number|percent|currency|compact, decimals? (percent defaults to 2 like the product), prefix?, suffix?, display?: final text override, from?: roll-up start}] -- 4 fit best (up to 6)

tile_height.label: KPI tile height in capture px (default 124)

funnel.label: Funnel bars: [{label: 'Sent', value: 18400}] -- labels are numbered '1. Sent' automatically (number_stages:false to skip)

axis_max.label: Y-axis max (default: auto nice scale above the biggest bar)

axis_format.label: Y tick format: plain (default, like the product '20000') | comma | compact

bar_values.label: Show each bar's value above it, counting up as it grows (default false -- the product shows them on hover only)

footer.label: 'Want to dig deeper?' card: {title, text, secondary: 'Open reports', primary: 'Ask the agent'}; false hides it

show_footer.label: false hides the footer card (the funnel takes the height)

entrance.label: rise (default: tiles land + roll up, bars grow) | none (settled from frame 0, for stills)

at.label: Shift the whole entrance by this many seconds (negative starts it under a relay join)

docked.label: true = sit flush in quotient-app-shell's content well (no outer border/shadow)

script.label: Performance: count {target, to, display?, duration?}, highlight {target, duration?, color?}, switch-tab {to}, set-text {target, to}, move-cursor / click / hover {target: visible text} / wait -- each with at (seconds)

cursor_targets.label: Explicit named cursor positions (optional; targets resolve to the real elements by their text)
